verdict.rationale: Honeybadger has an official CLI with a `honeybadger deploy` command and documented REST endpoints for deploy notification, source map upload, exception reporting and fault listing, all usable non-interactively from scripts and pipelines. Community users confirm automated deploy tracking through Capistrano. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline docs (e.g., GitHub Actions or CI token guidance), a CLI beyond the Ruby gem, and a published OpenAPI spec (probe found none).
